cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, time, subprocess, sys
rng = random.Random(3)
n = 48
links = []
seen = set()
while len(links) < 128:
    u = rng.randrange(n); v = rng.randrange(n)
    if u == v: continue
    key = (min(u,v), max(u,v))
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    links.append([u, v, 10**9])
parts = rng.sample(range(n), 32)
demand = [[v, rng.randint(0, 10**12)] for v in parts]
if sum(d for _, d in demand) == 0: demand[0][1] = 1
env = [[i, 10**9] for i in range(128)]
load = {'op':'load','n':n,'links':links,'bookings':[]}
prep = {'op':'prepare','id':'p1','owner':'alice','window':[100,1000],'period':10,
        'participants':demand,'envelope':env,'rev':0}
inp = json.dumps(load)+'\n'+json.dumps(prep)+'\n'
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/main.py'], input=inp.encode(), capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print('wall=%.2fs' % dt)
r = json.loads(lines[1])
print('status:', r['status'])
if r['status'] == 'prepared':
    pl = r['plan']
    print('trees:', len(pl['trees']), 'routes:', len(pl['routes']), 'recipes:', len(pl['recipes']))
    sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
    import compiler
    print('verify:', compiler.verify_plan([(u,v,c) for u,v,c in links], {i:10**9 for i in range(128)}, 10, dict(demand), pl))
